newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates mixed on low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates mixed on low demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were mixed on Tuesday amid a low demand from spinners and exporters and may come off on Wednesday, dealers said.

"Reports of stocks piling up at ginning factories and (new crop) arrivals gaining pace are likely to keep spinners to the sidelines," dealer Nasim Usman said, adding that buying might not filter in until the rates fell substantially.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,225 rupees ($55.32) per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
